description: This file defines the ClaimModuleController class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, responsible for handling claim module requests by redirecting to the default page based on user roles.

classes.name: ClaimModuleController
classes.description: Controller class managing claim module requests, extending AbstractModuleController and using UserRoleManagerTrait to handle role-based redirection.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Redirects the user to the default claim page based on their role.
